items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Like the trumpet player, what's his name? Ray Nance. Ray Nance could always play his part.

ctx.x: On the whole, we had a pretty good bunch of boys all the time, outside of the couple who went go for the dope. Like the trumpet player, what's his name? Ray Nance. Ray Nance could always play his part.
And he never did bother nobody.
